turns.replyText:
How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
To achieve the best results, consistency is key, as collagen works through daily, foundational support.
Depending on the product you choose, here is how we recommend incorporating it into your ritual:
True Collagen & Wild Collagen:
The recommended daily intake is 5g to 10g. This is approximately 1 to 2 heaped teaspoons (or one level Ritual Scoop, which provides roughly 8g). The powder is virtually tasteless and dissolves effortlessly into any hot or cold drink of your choice, such as tea, coffee, or water, as well as foods like porridge, yoghurt, smoothies, or soups. Some people choose to take their serving once a day, whilst others prefer to split it between morning and evening.
Noble Collagen:
The recommended serving is 1 capsule daily, preferably with a meal. You may take this morning or evening, though doing so at the same time every day helps support a consistent routine.
Radiant Collagyn:
Mix 2 to 3 teaspoons (around 10g) daily into warm milk, water, or blend into a smoothie.
You can also find detailed instructions for any product under the "How to use" section on its product page.
